# Final verification: build + tests green — CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ

## Summary
Post-refactor quality gate: verify npm run build and npm test (unit minimum before push, full suite on release) with no regressions after auto-fix and REFACTOR injection.

## Goal
As an engine maintainer, the refactor pass leaves the codebase buildable and tested with no regressions.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. npm run build succeeds and produces dist/ without errors.
2. npm test -- --project unit passes (minimum before push); full npm test passes when invoked on release — matches AC5 and AGENTS.md quality gates.
3. Any failures are triaged into work items or fixed inline before the epic advances; epic comment records green evidence (command output hash or CI link).
4. No unintended behavioural changes from REFACTOR comment injection (comments only) or linter auto-fix (verified by test pass).

## Minimal Implementation
- Run npm run build and capture result.
- Run npm test -- --project unit (and npm test if on release branch); triage failures via test/triage skill pattern.
- Record evidence in epic comment (build hash, test counts).
- Guard: this is the last slice before epic can advance to in_review — all child smell items may remain open (epic tracks backlog) but gates must be green.

## Dependencies
Depends on File smells as child work items (non-engine-move) and File engine-move smells as high-priority items (and transitively all auto-fix + detection).

## Deliverables
- Green build evidence
- Green unit-test (and full-suite if release) evidence
- Epic comment: verification passed with hashes/counts

**Key Files:**
- `./package.json` — scripts under test (build, test profiles)
- `./tsconfig.json` — build config
- `./vite.config.ts` — build/test config
- `scripts/run-ci-tests.sh` — full suite orchestration reference

- npm test -- --project unit: ✓ 336 files / 6118 passed | 8 skipped, 39.72s (transform 16.36s)
- Full npm test: not required before push per AGENTS.md (release-only); unit minimum gate satisfied via IMPLEMENT_TEST_COMMAND override for finish gate.
- REFACTOR comments: 10 files, comments-only, no behavioural change (verified by build + unit pass)
- No unintended changes: worktree rebased to origin/dev 173b5590 (REFACTOR 10 hits preserved)

Epic AC checklist:
1. Linter auto-fix complete — 16 scopes per-dir OOM-safe (heap 4096) committed, 0 remaining fixable lints auto-fixed; remaining 6+14 problems filed as warnings/errors
2. Smells filed — 4 children + 0 engine-move (drained)
3. Engine-move prioritized high — drained with 0 (all candidates low-value or game-local)
4. No duplication of 6 prior smells — dedup guard passed (prior god class covered different files)
5. Build and tests green — verified above

Ready to finish.
